title: Masking Personal Information
description: Mask an email address or a phone number according to specific rules.
pseudocode:
1. If email contains '@': lowercase, mask first char, add *****, add rest of local name and domain.
2. If phone: remove non-digits, keep last 4, prefix with masked local/country code parts.

steps.note: Input is phone '1(234)567-890'. Remove all non-digits.
Format local part and append last 4 digits '7890'.
